title: docs: add grill-me skill and ask agents to grill plans
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Added Matt Pocock’s `grill-me` and `grilling` skills for Claude Code, linked them for Codex, and pinned their sources in `skills-lock.json`. People can start an interview with `/grill-me`; agents use `grilling` directly. AGENTS.md now directs agents to stress-test non-trivial features, designs, API or pricing changes, quests, and plans with open choices before building. Agents ask all currently unblocked decisions in a numbered round with recommended answers, research facts themselves, and continue independent work while waiting. The skill requires user confirmation of shared understanding before acting; existing approval and safety rules still apply.

image.prompt: In a cozy garden-shed workspace, Polli wears tiny reading glasses and studies a branching plan on a lime green (#ecf874) CRT screen beside a pot of code-flowers. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, never oversized, and strictly pixel art. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a warm cream background and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
